"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Set a visually appealing style for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, y=1.02) # Adjust y to prevent overlap

# Plot 1: Survival Count by Sex
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=df, ax=axes[0, 0])

# Plot 4: Fare Distribution for Survivors vs. Non-Survivors

axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14)
